# GaMa – Gavin Magid Web and Online Marketing Solutions

> Websites, online marketing/advertising, and AI-built apps and tools for doctors, accountants, therapists and self-employed professionals in South Africa.

GaMa (Gavin Magid Web and Online Marketing Solutions) is based in Johannesburg and works with clients across South Africa. Services, in order: website design and build; online marketing with SEO and GEO (visibility in Google and in AI answers) plus Google, Facebook and Instagram advertising; Android app development; and AI-powered business software (booking systems, client dashboards, internal tools) built with AI assistance and always designed and reviewed by a person.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.gamaonlinemarketing.co.za/): services, process, FAQ, contact
- [Blog](https://www.gamaonlinemarketing.co.za/blog/): plain-English guides on websites, marketing and AI for small business

## Live projects
- [Joburg North Psychology](https://joburgnorthpsychology.co.za): practice website and admin backend for a clinical psychologist (client project)
- [BuySave](https://buysave.co.za): online store for mini PCs and technology deals
- [BuySave Shop](https://shop.buysave.co.za): custom storefront for mini PCs and laptops with Rand pricing
- [ProblemSolved](https://problemsolved.org.za): South African consumer dispute tracker
- [ZAVoiceAI](https://zavoiceai.online): AI call screening for South African mobile numbers
- [ZaCart](https://zacart.online): grocery price comparison across South African stores
